page.overview:
What is Foxy the Pirate?

Foxy the Pirate is a minor recurring character in the Tales from the Pizzaplex series and is one of the main mascots of the Freddy Fazbear's Pizza family entertainment restaurant chain.

Foxy is an anthropomorphic animatronic fox with red fur, an red-orange body, and darker red highlights in his inner ears. He wears an eye patch over his right eye and has a hook in-place of his right hand. He has yellow eyes, three tuffs of hair on the top of his head and on his shoulders, and a few golden teeth.

Appears on the Fast Freddy as a jumpscare in the middle of the rollercoaster.

Luca sees a girl wearing a Foxy costume in Urban Legends Role Play Auditorium. Inside, a Foxy statue, being puppeteer by ropes and pullies, swipes its hook at Maddy.
